description.zh: 用无头 Blender 把文字描述或实拍短片变成白模 blocking 动画：占位人偶、走位、过肩/推拉等镜头语言、剪辑节奏，直接产出可喂给视频生成模型的运镜参考。
description.en: Turns text briefs or live-action shorts into whitebox blocking animations with headless Blender — capsule actors, staging, OTS/dolly camera language and cut rhythm, ready as motion references for video-generation models.

welcome_message.zh: 把描述或实拍短片变成带运镜的白模分镜动画
welcome_message.en: Turn briefs or footage into camera-matched whitebox blocking

description.zh: 过肩正反打 + 走位的白模分镜

prompt.zh: 帮我做一个 15 秒双人对话白模场景：（描述两个角色、关系、地点、氛围，例如：港式夜景街角，警察与卧底对峙，一方转身离开）。要求有过肩镜头和明确的镜头切换节奏。
prompt.en: Make a 15s whitebox two-hander scene: (describe characters, relationship, location, mood). Include over-the-shoulder shots and clear cut rhythm.

description.zh: 拆片分析镜头语言并重建
description.en: Analyze a short and rebuild as blocking

prompt.zh: 这是我的一段实拍短片（附上文件路径）：请先拆镜头（边界、时长、每镜头的景别与运镜），再用白模逐镜头重建，保持原片的剪辑节奏和机位关系。
prompt.en: Here is my live-action short (file path attached): first break it into shots (boundaries, durations, framing, camera moves), then rebuild it as whitebox blocking matching the original cut rhythm.

description.zh: 几何体/产品白模环绕展示

prompt.zh: 用白模风格渲一段产品转台动画：（描述主体物件的几何构成、时长、分辨率），材质用浅灰黏土，镜头环绕缓推。
prompt.en: Render a whitebox clay turntable animation of: (describe the object's geometry, duration, resolution), light-gray clay material, orbiting slow-push camera.

description.zh: 指定一个镜头语言单独出片

prompt.zh: 只渲一个镜头给我看效果：（描述镜头，例如：低角度缓推穿过一组建筑体量，最后停在一个人偶背影上，8 秒，手持微抖）。
prompt.en: Render just one shot: (describe the camera move, e.g. low-angle slow dolly through building masses ending on a figure's back, 8s, subtle handheld).

zh: 把 ~/Videos/short.mp4 拆镜头重建成 15 秒白模 blocking，保持原剪辑节奏
做一个雨夜天台双人对坐谈话的白模场景，含一个过肩一个反打
渲一段 8 秒产品转台：主体是立方体+圆柱组合，720p，缓推收尾
en: Rebuild ~/Videos/short.mp4 as a 15s whitebox blocking matching its cut rhythm
Block a rainy-night rooftop two-hander with one OTS and one reverse
Render an 8s product turntable: cube + cylinder subject, 720p, slow push-in ending
